source_name: 33_01_图片库＆设计资源_中文_女士_Chanel_Pre-Summer_2027_服装__033_media_cha_biarritz_ps27_016_text_description.md
text_description: A cream and vivid red coordinated look shown from the lower torso to the feet, built around a soft, close-fitting long-sleeve top and a matching high-waisted midi skirt. The top is cream with sleeves pushed or cropped to the forearm, finished with bold red cuffs; its neckline and full upper shape are out of frame. The skirt sits high on the waist with a horizontal red waistband and a cream body that falls to below the knee in a gently straight-to-slightly-flared silhouette. A red front trim runs down from the waistband and curves around a dramatic high front slit, exposing most of one thigh, with three small round gold buttons placed along the red placket near the upper front. The skirt hem is finished with a red border, including a wider red accent along the lower edge. Styling is polished and resort-like: chunky brown and gold bracelets on both wrists, a small woven straw handbag carried at the side, and neutral beige pointed or almond-toe heels visible at the bottom. The color palette is warm cream contrasted sharply with saturated red and gold hardware, creating a refined nautical or Riviera-inspired mood.
